title: ジャパンダートダービーの後に・立心

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text: Now that I've finished the Japan DD, I've figured out what it is that makes Umamusume so cute and divine…

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text: It's because they're always earnestly chasing their dreams! I wanna be like that too, so I can stand next to Opera O and Doto one day!

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text: Now I have to get ready to race against King and the other senior runners in the Mile Championship! King actually ran in this race last year too. I can't wait! ☆
